prompt.title: LinkedIn profile read and navigation actions
prompt.instructions: Operate only user-authorized LinkedIn profile pages. Prefer these profile-specific actions before generic DOM or viewport fallback. For LinkedIn profile pages, the visible document may not scroll through window or body; scroll the main content container instead.
prompt.state_summary: LinkedIn profile pages render the profile header, About, Featured, and Activity inside a scrollable main element. The default viewport scroll primitive can report moved=false with window scrollY remaining 0. A scoped viewport.scroll targeting main moves the profile content and reveals lower sections.

states.name: linkedin_profile_visible
states.description: A LinkedIn profile page is visible.

states.name: linkedin_profile_main_scroll_container
states.description: The profile content scrolls inside the main element rather than the top-level viewport.

states.name: linkedin_profile_lower_sections_visible
states.description: Lower profile content such as Activity, posts, profile language, and public profile URL has been revealed by scrolling the main container.

tools.name: linkedin.profile.visible_text.read
tools.description: Read visible text from the current LinkedIn profile page. Use for profile header, About, Featured, Activity, and post text currently mounted in the page.

tools.name: linkedin.profile.sections.list
tools.description: List rendered LinkedIn profile sections with inferred headings, offsets, and visibility. Use before and after scrolling the profile main container.

tools.name: linkedin.profile.main.scroll
tools.description: Scroll the LinkedIn profile's main content container down by 900 CSS pixels. Use this instead of unscoped viewport.scroll on profile pages; default viewport scroll can fail with moved=false.

tools.name: linkedin.profile.main.scroll_up
tools.description: Scroll the LinkedIn profile's main content container up by 900 CSS pixels. Use this to return toward the profile header after reading lower sections.

tools.name: linkedin.profile.links.read
tools.description: Extract visible LinkedIn profile links from the current profile page, including profile, company, school, featured, and post links that are mounted in the DOM.

tools.name: linkedin.profile.capture_authoring_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a rendered screenshot of the current LinkedIn profile viewport for authoring diagnostics. This is privileged in the extension and user-consented in bookmarklet/embed-style runtimes.

workflows.name: collect_profile_bio_context
workflows.description: Read visible profile text, list rendered sections, scroll the main profile container, then read visible text and sections again. Use this workflow before drafting a short or long speaker bio from a LinkedIn profile.
workflows.note: If lower sections such as Experience and Education are not mounted after one scroll, repeat linkedin.profile.main.scroll with delta_y 900 and re-run linkedin.profile.sections.list. Do not use unscoped viewport.scroll for this surface.
